name: Heroic Sacrifice
oracle_text: Choose target creature you control. Until end of turn, all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control is dealt to the chosen creature instead (if it's still on the battlefield). When that creature dies this turn, put its counters on up to one target creature you control and draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Choose target creature you control. Until end of turn, all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control is dealt to the chosen creature instead (if it's still on the battlefield).
When that creature dies this turn, put its counters on up to one target creature you control and draw a card.

needs.what: a one-shot spell op creating an until-end-of-turn replacement effect: all damage that would be dealt to you (the player) and to creatures you control is dealt instead to one chosen (targeted) creature, applying only while that creature is still on the battlefield (and not redirecting damage already aimed at it)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage / prevent_damage_permanent only prevent damage, never re-deal it to another object; replace_damage is a static_effect that needs a permanent source, not a timed effect created by an instant; redirect_attack moves attackers, not damage

needs.what: a this-turn delayed trigger keyed to the spell's chosen creature dying, whose effect moves the counters it had (last-known information, all kinds) onto up to one new target creature you control and draws a card
needs.why_existing_wont_do: delayed_trigger exists, but move_counters reads counters from an object on the battlefield; the dead creature's counters need last-known information (only counters_had as a value, not as a source for moving every kind), and the delayed trigger must choose a fresh 'up to one' target on firing
